diagnostic_fields.code: string — compile diagnostics: enum code from lang.passes.base.Diagnostic; analysis diagnostics: analyzer string code; ADAPTER_ERROR / SERIALIZE_ERROR are diagnostic codes, never statuses
diagnostic_fields.file: python-side field — emitted by _normalize_compile_diag (compile_cli.py:38-39) only when Diagnostic.filename is truthy. The sole filename-carrying diagnostic is the LANGUAGE_IDENTITY gate (pipeline.py:113-126), which fires only when required_language_identity is passed — compile_cli.py never passes it, so `file` is unreachable in the CLI contract surface (verified: 0 'file' keys across all 62 oracle snapshots). Go never emits it.
diagnostic_fields.location: optional string — compile diagnostics only; span text 'file:line:col-file:line:col'; absent when the diagnostic carries no source span
diagnostic_fields.node_id: optional string — analysis diagnostics only; Go emits the key always for analysis diagnostics (null when the node is unknown, mirroring _normalize_analysis_diag compile_cli.py:46-54); compile diagnostics never carry node_id (Task 36 ported the analyzer stage)
diagnostic_fields.path: optional string — analysis diagnostics only; Go emits the key always for analysis diagnostics (null when empty); compile diagnostics never carry path (Task 36 ported the analyzer stage)
diagnostic_fields.severity: enum string — 'error' | 'warning' (compile diagnostics are always 'error'; analysis may warn) (INFO is defined in the reference Severity enum — passes/base.py:41-44 — but no diagnostic in the codebase emits it, so it is not part of the frozen enum)

notes: All 7 top-level fields are present on every response: Python compile_to_json always returns base + status/ok/yaml/yaml_sha256/diagnostics; Go CompileToJSON emits them unconditionally.
ADAPTER_ERROR and SERIALIZE_ERROR are diagnostic codes inside COMPILE_ERROR / YAML_VALIDATION_ERROR responses — Python never sets them as status (api.go Status* constants comment).
Go CLI byte shape mirrors Python json.dump(ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) + trailing newline (api.go MarshalContractJSON).
yaml_sha256 is sha256 hex of the exact yaml bytes (Python hashlib.sha256(yaml_text.encode()).hexdigest()); Go sha256.Sum256 over the same bytes.

top_level_fields.diagnostics: array of diagnostic objects (may be empty)
top_level_fields.yaml: string — serialized Dify workflow YAML; empty string on non-SUCCEEDED
top_level_fields.yaml_sha256: string — hex sha256 of the yaml bytes; empty string on non-SUCCEEDED
